scene_summary: A distressed cream paper plate holds a compact upper collage of a dark portrait, blue triangular fragment, printed statistical marks, and a large cream shoe cropped along its lower edge. A red strip of disjointed arms and hands runs across the lower portion. The shoe is the single mapped source-bearing feature; the surrounding print fragments remain compositional support.
usable_surfaces: Cream printed shoe fragment with stacked dark lace loops, curved toe outline, and fine side seam

detected_objects.label: Cream shoe fragment with stacked dark lace loops and heavy curved outline
detected_objects.visual_evidence: At upper right, a cream shoe fragment has a rounded toe enclosed by a thick distressed dark outline. Stacked dark lace loops cross its left-facing opening, with visible eyelets and a thin curved seam inside the right edge. The blue triangular fragment occludes part of its lower-left side, and a cream diagonal cut crops the bottom. The polygon follows the visible shoe silhouette rather than treating a single lace loop or the surrounding collage as an independent target.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Two collage bands leave substantial cream negative space, and the shoe remains legible. However, the portrait, shoe, blue triangle, and red hand strip compete for attention; distressed texture and small statistical marks add density. The plate is restrained collage rather than strictly minimal expressionism, but it is not excessively cluttered.
